title: YUBI-Real2Sim: 3DGS Scene Verification for Reliable Policy Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.17521v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evaluating VLA policies on real robots is costly, time-consuming, and difficult to reproduce, making real-to-sim simulation essential for scalable evaluation. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables rapid real-to-sim scene generation, the reconstruction quality required for reliable policy evaluation remains unquantified. In particular, policies relying on wrist-mounted fisheye cameras (e.g., YUBI handheld gripper data) are heavily exposed to visual artifacts (holes, floaters) in wide-angle views, directly degrading task performance. To address this, we present YUBI-Real2Sim, a unified framework for 3DGS-based scene reconstruction and real-to-sim policy evaluation under dual fisheye wrist views. translated_title: YUBI-Real2Sim：面向可靠策略评估的3DGS场景验证
translated_abstract: 在真实机器人上评估VLA（视觉-语言-动作）策略成本高昂、耗时且难以复现，因此真实到仿真（real-to-sim）转换对于可扩展的评估至关重要。虽然3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）能够快速生成真实到仿真的场景，但可靠策略评估所需的重建质量仍未被量化。尤其是，依赖腕戴式鱼眼相机的策略（例如YUBI手持夹爪数据）在广角视图中会严重暴露于视觉伪影（空洞、漂浮物）之下，直接降低任务性能。为解决这一问题，我们提出了YUBI-Real2Sim，一个在双鱼眼腕部视角下进行基于3DGS的场景重建与真实到仿真策略评估的统一框架。我们开发了一套集成流程，结合了200度鱼眼相机采集、3DGS训练、用于物体建模的3D基础模型，以及基于MuJoCo的物理仿真，在九项中的八项复现了所观察到的真实世界策略排序。
tldr: 提出YUBI-Real2Sim统一框架，通过双鱼眼腕部视角下的3DGS场景重建、3D基础模型与MuJoCo物理仿真的集成流程，实现了可靠的真到模策略评估，并在九项中的八项复现了真实世界的策略排序。
en_tdlr: YUBI-Real2Sim offers a unified 3DGS-based real-to-sim framework combining dual fisheye wrist views, 3D foundation models, and MuJoCo physics simulation to enable reliable policy evaluation, reproducing the real-world policy ordering in eight of nine cases.
